name: Gateway Internet Services
summary: Early dialup + hosting ISP (site from Dec 1996); defunct (THE INTERNET TRUST & BUNBURY INTERNET SERVICES PTY LTD (PARTNERSHIP; LATER CIPHERTEL PTY LTD) (partnership), ABN 65 540 299 417).

events.details: Acquired by CipherTel Pty Ltd — business acquired by CipherTel.

refs.label: gateway.net.au stayed branded until ~2014, then began redirecting to CipherTel; today gateway.net.au serves CipherTel.
Old partnership ABN cancelled 2001; the trading name was then carried by CipherTel from 2002-08-08.
